source_event_text: Goal!  Arsenal 1, Liverpool 0. Theo Walcott (Arsenal) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Alex Iwobi.

Goal!  Arsenal 1, Liverpool 3. Philippe Coutinho (Liverpool) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Nathaniel Clyne with a cross.
Goal!  Arsenal 1, Liverpool 4. Sadio Mané (Liverpool) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Adam Lallana.
